title: THE KEY LISTS SAY THE NEW BELT
why: His order of 2026-10-13: redo the bar at the bottom. Build 8 of 8, the words. Every list of keys now says the new belt: keys 1 to 4 are guns, 5 and 6 throwables, 7 and 8 medical, 9 armour. now: The key lists now say 1-4 guns, 5-6 throwables, 7-8 medical and 9 armour.
